# Complete Example: Research Assistant

This chapter is a full walkthrough of a multi-tool research workflow: from query to structured findings to human review.

## This Chapter Will Cover

- Tool design for research (search, fetch, extract, summarize)
- Orchestration patterns for multi-step work (plan → execute → synthesize)
- Human review before publishing or acting on results
- Durability + resumability (long-running research without losing progress)
- Specs and evals that keep research quality from drifting
